title: shared_ptr lifetime counters
prompt: Implement `struct SharedProbe` with a static `alive()` counter (constructor increments, destructor decrements) and the free function `int probe_lifetimes()` that: creates a `shared_ptr<SharedProbe>`, copies it, lets the copy go out of scope in an inner block, then resets the original — returning `alive()` measured after all of that. Correct code returns 0; the test proves both the copy and the reset released.

tests.name: everything-released
tests.hint: Copy, inner scope, and reset — every owner must release.
